conversation.Statement: Good morning, this is Agent Thomas from the IRS Tax Refund Department. Am I speaking to Mr. Davis, owner of Davis & Co.?
Yes, this is him. What is this about?
I'm contacting you regarding your 2023 tax filing. Our records show you're eligible for a federal stimulus refund of $3,200 due to recent legislative changes affecting small business owners.
Oh, really? I wasn't expecting that. Is this related to the extra forms I submitted last month?

Yes, exactly. The IRS reviewed your Schedule C and determined you're owed this refund. However, before we can release the funds, you are required to complete a mandatory identity verification and processing payment.
A payment? I thought refunds just go straight to my account?
Under new federal guidelines to prevent identity theft, all refunds over $2,000 require a one-time clearance fee. For your case, this fee is $289, which will be refunded alongside your payment.
That seems odd. I've never heard of a refund fee before.

I understand your concern, Mr. Davis. However, this is a recent IRS protocol for small businesses due to increased fraud this year. If this isn't completed today, the refund will be forfeited and you may face compliance penalties.
Penalties? That sounds serious. I really can't afford any more trouble with taxes.
Exactly. You don't want to risk an IRS audit or legal action, sir. Let's process this now so you receive your refund smoothly. Do you have a debit or credit card available for the clearance fee?
I have a business debit card. How do I pay the fee?
You can provide the card number, expiration date, and security code. Our secure system will process the $289, and your full refund will be sent to your business account within 24 hours.
I'm nervous about giving out card info. Can I pay another way?

We also accept payment through Zelle or via an instant wire transfer. But please note, any delay could result in your case being flagged for non-compliance, which can trigger fines or even a temporary freeze on your business account.
Alright, I guess debit card is fastest. The number is 4456 8310 2234 1199, expiration 09/27, CVV 572.
Thank you. Please stay on the line while I process your payment. Do not disconnect, as this is required for IRS verification.
Okay, I'm here.
Your payment is being processed now. For your records, the charge will appear as 'IRS Clearance.' Do you have access to your email? You'll receive a refund confirmation shortly.
Yes, I can check my email. Will I get the refund right away?

Once the clearance is complete, your $3,200 refund and the $289 fee will be deposited by the end of the business day. If there is any issue with your card, I will need you to provide an alternative payment method immediately to avoid escalation.
Alright. Just to be sure, there's no other paperwork, right?

No, this is the final step. If you fail to complete it today, your refund will be revoked, and your business could face an IRS compliance review. I recommend handling this now to avoid unnecessary complications.
